list.title: Disrupt fungal cell walls:
list.snippet: They interfere with the synthesis of essential components of the fungal cell wall, leading to its weakening and eventual destruction.

list.title: Inhibit fungal enzyme activity:
list.snippet: They block enzymes that are crucial for fungal growth and metabolism, preventing the fungus from multiplying and spreading.

list.title: Alter fungal membrane function:
list.snippet: They alter the permeability of the fungal cell membrane, allowing harmful substances to enter and disrupting cellular processes.

text_blocks.snippet: Examples of antifungal medications commonly used for athlete's foot include: clotrimazole, miconazole, terbinafine, and tolnaftate.
